fps_max: Frame rate cap in matches. 0 means no cap.
engine_no_focus_sleep: How long the game sleeps per frame while it's in the background (milliseconds). Higher saves power when alt-tabbed.
r_low_latency: NVIDIA Reflex / low-latency mode. Lowers input lag; 0 turns it off.
r_ssao: Ambient occlusion (soft contact shadows). Off gives more FPS and flatter-looking scenes.
r_ssao_strength: How dark ambient occlusion shadows are.
r_citadel_ssao_quality: Ambient occlusion quality. Lower is faster.
r_citadel_shadow_quality: Shadow quality. Lower is faster and blurrier.
r_citadel_fog_quality: Volumetric fog quality. Lower is faster.
r_citadel_antialiasing: Anti-aliasing mode. Off is sharper and faster but shows jagged edges.
r_citadel_upscaling: Upscaling mode (FSR/DLSS). Renders at a lower resolution and scales up for more FPS.
r_citadel_distancefield_ao_quality: Quality of large-scale ambient occlusion from distance fields. Lower is faster.
r_citadel_distancefield_shadows: Soft shadows from distance fields. Off is faster.
r_citadel_disable_particle_lights: Stops particle effects from casting light. Saves GPU time in fights.
r_depth_of_field: Blur on far or near objects. Off keeps the whole screen sharp.
r_effects_bloom: Glow around bright light. Off is a bit faster and clearer.
r_post_bloom: Glow around bright light in post-processing. Off is a bit faster and clearer.
r_drawdecals: Bullet holes, scorch marks and other decals. Off is faster.
r_decals: Maximum number of decals kept in the world. Lower is faster.
r_drawropes: Draws ropes and cables in the map.
r_drawtracers_firstperson: Bullet tracers for your own shots.
r_draw3dskybox: Draws the distant 3D sky scenery. Off is faster.
r_rendersun: Draws the sun disc and its glow.
r_texture_stream_max_resolution: Largest texture size loaded. Lower uses less VRAM and looks blurrier.
r_texture_stream_mip_bias: Shifts textures toward lower detail levels. Higher uses less VRAM and looks blurrier.
r_texturefilteringquality: Texture filtering (anisotropic). Higher keeps far surfaces sharp at a small GPU cost.
r_particle_max_detail_level: Highest particle detail. Lower makes ability effects simpler and faster.
r_particle_max_draw_distance: How far away particles are still drawn.
r_propsmaxdist: How far away props are still drawn.
r_farz: Far clipping distance. Things beyond it aren't drawn.
r_aspectratio: Forces an aspect ratio, e.g. for stretched resolutions. 0 uses the screen's.
r_drawviewmodel: Draws your own weapon and arms.
mat_viewportscale: Render scale. Below 1 renders fewer pixels for more FPS and a blurrier image.
mat_colorcorrection: Map colour grading. Off shows plain colours.
csm_max_num_cascades_override: Number of sun shadow cascades. Fewer is faster; far shadows get worse.
csm_max_visible_dist: How far away sun shadows are drawn.
csm_viewmodel_shadows: Shadows on your own weapon and arms.
lb_enable_shadow_casting: Shadows from lights other than the sun. Off is much faster.
lb_dynamic_shadow_resolution: Lets shadow resolution change with distance.
sc_screen_size_lod_scale_override: Level-of-detail scale. Higher switches models to simpler versions sooner.
cl_disable_ragdolls: Turns off ragdoll physics for dead units.
cl_ragdoll_limit: Maximum number of ragdolls at once.
cl_particle_max_count: Maximum number of particles alive at once.
cl_interp_ratio: Network interpolation buffer, in ticks. Lower shows enemies more up to date but can stutter on bad connections.
cl_updaterate: Snapshots per second requested from the server.
citadel_camera_hero_fov: Field of view for the hero camera.
viewmodel_fov: Field of view of your weapon and arms.
citadel_player_model_force_highest_lod: Always draws heroes at full detail, even far away. Slower.
citadel_trooper_glow_disabled: Turns off the glow on troopers.
citadel_boss_glow_disabled: Turns off the glow on bosses and objectives.
citadel_melee_shake_amplitude: Strength of the screen shake on melee hits.
citadel_death_ragdoll_duration: How long dead heroes stay on the ground.
citadel_cinematic_intro_enabled: Plays the short intro camera at the start of a match.
panorama_disable_blur: Turns off blur behind menus and HUD panels. Faster.
panorama_disable_box_shadow: Turns off shadows on menu and HUD panels. Faster.
snd_mixahead: Audio buffer length in seconds. Lower reduces sound delay; too low can crackle.
snd_steamaudio_enable_reverb: Steam Audio reverb. Off is cheaper on the CPU.
snd_steamaudio_enable_pathing: Steam Audio sound paths around corners. Off is cheaper on the CPU.
cpu_level: Overall CPU detail level used by the engine (0 low, 1 medium, 2 high).
gpu_level: Overall GPU detail level used by the engine.
thread_pool_option: How many worker threads the engine uses.
